description: This file contains shared plugin functions for Smarty, focusing on Unicode character conversions between strings and their decimal Unicode representations.

methods.name: smarty_mb_to_unicode
methods.description: Converts characters in a string to their decimal Unicode equivalents, returning an array of unicode code points.

methods.name: smarty_mb_from_unicode
methods.description: Converts Unicode code points back into a string in the specified encoding.
